name: Kinsta
tagline: Premium managed WordPress hosting on Google Cloud Platform
description: Kinsta is a premium managed WordPress hosting provider built entirely on Google Cloud Platform infrastructure, priced per site with monthly-visit and PHP-worker-based tiers rather than the budget cPanel-shared-hosting model.
about: Kinsta's entry-level Single Site plan starts at $35/month billed monthly (or roughly $30/month billed annually), including one WordPress site, 35,000 monthly visits and 10GB storage. Multi-site Business plans scale from $70/month (2 sites, 70,000 visits) up through $450/month (40 sites, 750,000 visits), and Agency and Enterprise tiers run further above that. Unlike promo-driven shared hosts, Kinsta's pricing is largely flat year over year — annual billing saves about two months' cost rather than functioning as a low-then-high renewal trap.

Every plan is metered on monthly visits, storage and CDN bandwidth, and going over any of them triggers real overage charges rather than a hard cutoff: $0.50 per 1,000 extra visits, $2 per GB per month of extra disk space (prorated daily), and $0.05 per GB of extra CDN bandwidth. There's no cPanel here — everything runs through Kinsta's own MyKinsta dashboard — and traffic-spiky or high-PHP-worker-demand sites can outgrow a tier's resources faster than the sticker price suggests, so it's worth checking MyKinsta's usage analytics before assuming the next renewal will match the first bill.
policies: Kinsta offers a 30-day money-back guarantee for first-time customers on Managed WordPress Hosting plans. It doesn't reset if you switch plans mid-period, and any overage fees or add-ons incurred are deducted from the refund rather than returned in full.

faqs.q: What happens if I exceed my plan's visit limit on Kinsta?
faqs.a: Kinsta doesn't take your site offline for going over — it bills an overage fee of $0.50 per 1,000 extra monthly visits, plus separate overage rates for disk space ($2/GB/month) and CDN bandwidth ($0.05/GB) if those limits are also exceeded.

faqs.q: Does Kinsta include free site migrations?
faqs.a: Yes — Kinsta includes unlimited free WordPress site migrations on every plan, handled by its migration team rather than a self-service plugin only.

faqs.q: Is Kinsta a budget hosting option?
faqs.a: No. Kinsta is positioned as premium managed WordPress hosting starting around $35/month for a single low-traffic site, built on Google Cloud Platform — it's priced well above budget cPanel shared hosts like Hostinger or Namecheap in exchange for managed infrastructure, daily backups and WordPress-specialized support.

faqs.q: Does Kinsta offer a money-back guarantee?
faqs.a: Yes — Kinsta backs its plans with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can request a refund if it's not a good fit.

faqs.q: Do I need a promo code to get Kinsta's best price?
faqs.a: Not always — some Kinsta deals apply automatically at checkout, while others require pasting a revealed code into the promo/coupon field before you pay. Check each listing above for details.

faqs.q: How do I get started with Kinsta?
faqs.a: Pick a plan that fits your needs on Kinsta's website, complete checkout, and your account is usually ready within minutes.

faqs.q: Is Kinsta good value for hosting?
faqs.a: Kinsta is one of the more popular hosting providers — compare its plans and any current deal above against your specific needs before committing.

faqs.q: Can I cancel my Kinsta plan anytime?
faqs.a: Most Kinsta plans can be cancelled from your account dashboard; check Kinsta's own terms for any minimum-term or refund conditions that apply to your plan.

faqs.q: How often are Kinsta deals updated?
faqs.a: Our team checks Kinsta's offers regularly and updates this page when new deals go live or old ones expire.
